name: Tenshi no Scanty
source:
Main character works at Moriyama Country Club together with his childhood friend Ayano. But enterprise is on the brink of bankruptcy, so it's hastily re-branded into a lingerie restaurant. Protagonist remains a waiter here, but he could not have hoped to work with so many girls wearing nothing but sexy lingerie!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公与青梅竹马绫乃一起在森山乡村俱乐部工作。但企业濒临破产，仓促改造成内衣餐厅。主人公仍在此担任服务员，却从未奢望能与这么多只穿性感内衣的女孩共事！

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
